## Direct Kit Support for Antigravity Desktop App on Local Computer (macOS / Linux) — Review Bundle

> **Scope note:** This patch adds direct board-kit support for the **Antigravity desktop app running locally on a computer (macOS / Linux)** — **not** Antigravity on the web (and **not** remote cloud devbox mode).
>
> **Attachment note:** The token-scoped `/_share/<token>/submit` endpoint accepts JSON `text` up to 500 KB and does not expose a binary `/_blob/` upload route. To guarantee the reviewing session has everything without hitting `404 blob_not_found`, the complete, `git apply --check`-verified unified patch (61.7 KB, covering all 14 source files, synced `.kit/` mirrors, and `tests/test_antigravity_app_local.py`) is embedded verbatim below.

### Base & Summary
- **Target repo / branch / base commit:** `anlonlt/board`, `feat/streamline-doctor-memory` @ `c053208`
- **Patch stats:** `28 files changed, 592 insertions(+), 111 deletions(-)` (`61,746` bytes)
- **What this fixes for Antigravity desktop app on a computer:**
  1. **Stock macOS Python 3.9 compatibility (`kit/hooks/kit_guard.py`):** Added `from __future__ import annotations` so PEP 604 `str | None` / `int | None` annotations (lines 28, 112, 248, 297) no longer raise `TypeError` and cause fail-closed `{"decision": "deny"}` on every `run_command`/`invoke_subagent` on stock macOS `/usr/bin/python3` (3.9.6).
  2. **macOS hook timeout crash (`kit/hook.py`):** `_Hook._kill()` called Linux-only `os.waitid()`, crashing with `AttributeError: module 'os' has no attribute 'waitid'` whenever any hook timed out on macOS. Added an `os.waitpid(self.pid, os.WNOHANG)` polling fallback when `os.waitid` is absent.
  3. **Unified Antigravity transcript discovery (`kit/hooks/kit_config.py`, `kit/hooks/kit_task_train.py`, `kit/hooks/kit_pre_compact.py`, `scripts/usage.py`, `scripts/kit.py`, `scripts/step0_scan.py`):** Previously hardcoded `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/...`. Now checks `$ANTIGRAVITY_APP_DATA_DIR`, `~/.gemini/antigravity` (desktop app), `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli` (CLI), and `~/.gemini/antigravity-ide` (IDE), picking the newest existing `transcript.jsonl`.
  4. **Native Antigravity desktop session & runtime detection (`scripts/kit.py`, `scripts/usage.py`, `kit/handover.py`, `kit/board/board_cli.py`, `kit/landing.py`, `kit/hooks/kit_memory_jit.py`, `scripts/step0_scan.py`, `scripts/run_all_tests.py`):** Recognizes `ANTIGRAVITY_CONVERSATION_ID`, `ANTIGRAVITY_AGENT`, `ANTIGRAVITY_APP_DATA_DIR`, `AGY_CONVERSATION_ID`, and `__CFBundleIdentifier=com.google.antigravity` (so macOS desktop app works without Linux `/proc` or `AGY_PID`), enables `kit.py` `_usage_self()` and `whoami` for desktop sessions, and sanitizes all `ANTIGRAVITY_*` / `AGY_*` vars in `run_all_tests.py` `SESSION_VARS`.
  5. **OS sandbox resilience (`scripts/device.py`):** When running inside Antigravity desktop app's Standard Sandbox Mode (which blocks `~/.config/board-kit` with `PermissionError`), `device.py` `run()`, `save_store()`, and `load_store()` fall back cleanly to `<tempdir>/board-kit-<uid>` unless `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` / `KIT_JOBS_DIR` is explicitly set.

### Verification Results (macOS 26.6.2 arm64, stock Python 3.9.6)
- **Live desktop-app session proof:**
  - `python3 -I .kit/usage.py --root . self --no-push` → `2026-11-26T23:26 part R1 transcript 35b7c7c5-b7a out=67887 cread=7179245 calls=52 tools=164 turns=2 $3.27`
  - `python3 -I .kit/kit.py whoami` → `35b7c7c5-b7a5-4ba7-a584-ad6ed7599e9e`
- **Test suites run (`python3 scripts/run_all_tests.py -j 1 antigravity_app_local kit_copies_current cl44_agy_runtime cl37_usage device_and_takeover unified_hooks landing handoff launch_runtime`):**
  - `tests/test_antigravity_app_local.py`: **11/11 PASS** (1.1 s)
  - `tests/test_cl44_agy_runtime.py`: **20/20 PASS** (5.3 s)
  - `tests/test_cl37_usage.py`: **32/32 PASS** (4.9 s)
  - `tests/test_device_and_takeover.py`: **24/24 PASS** (5.3 s)
  - `tests/test_handoff.py`: **7/7 PASS** (11.9 s)
  - `tests/test_landing.py`: **35/35 PASS** (65.4 s)
  - `tests/test_launch_runtime.py`: **9/9 PASS** (3.6 s)
  - `tests/test_unified_hooks.py`: **19/19 PASS** (51.1 s)
  - `tests/test_kit_copies_current.py`: **2/2 PASS** (0.1 s)
  - **Total: 9 suites passed, 159 tests passed, 0 failed.**
- **Clean apply check:** `git apply --check antigravity-app-local-kit-support.patch` → exit `0` against `c053208`.

### How to Apply & Review
1. Extract the diff block below into `antigravity-app-local-kit-support.patch` on a clean checkout of `anlonlt/board` (`feat/streamline-doctor-memory`).
2. Run:
   ```sh
   git apply --check antigravity-app-local-kit-support.patch
   git apply antigravity-app-local-kit-support.patch
   python3 -m unittest tests.test_antigravity_app_local tests.test_kit_copies_current tests.test_unified_hooks tests.test_cl44_agy_runtime tests.test_cl37_usage tests.test_device_and_takeover -v
   ```
3. *(Optional)* Run `python3 -I install.py . --update` to verify manifest hashes stay clean.
